notes: «وغير، واحد» is an unnamed transmitter (rule 8), co-transmitter with عبد بن حميد; the editor's gloss «- المعنى واحد -» is left out
«عن قتادة، حدثنا الحسن» continues the chain: Qatada narrates from al-Hasan, then al-Hasan from Abu Hurayra
Tirmidhi's remark that al-Hasan did not hear from Abu Hurayra names other critics, not a route of this saying
